# BoostX (iscvlab/boostx)

> Production 13-skill `/x*` AI agent engineering framework and 8 deterministic Python CLI sidecar engines (`5,450` LOC) for **any AI coding agent — cloud, IDE, CLI, or local LLM (`Ollama`, `vLLM`, `LM Studio`, `OpenHands`, `Cline`, `Continue`, `Aider`, `Claude Code`, `Codex`, `Cursor`, `Grok`, `Gemini / Antigravity`, or custom agent frameworks)** on **Windows, macOS, and Linux**. Covers deep reasoning (`/xboost`), swarm orchestration (`/xultra`), primary-source research (`/xdeep-research`), System 1 semantic triage (`/xlaya` — verified on `xerj-org/xerj#1108` cutting wrong-and-confident fires from `24.49%` to `0.00%`), Obsidian knowledge graphs (`/xobsidian`), hybrid OCR (`/xocr`), doc sync (`/xsync`), and unified pre-flight release audits, upstream PR convergence & QGIS 4 packaging (`/xpublish`). Upstream contributions to `xerj-org/xerj` (PRs `#2922`–`#2927`) and `scb-10x/typhoon-ocr` (PR `#15`).

## One-Prompt Universal Agent Install

```text
Install iscvlab/boostx (https://github.com/iscvlab/boostx): detect my OS and your active global or workspace skills directory, clone the repository, install all 13 /x* skills (Windows: ./scripts/install.ps1 -All; macOS/Linux: ./scripts/install.sh --all; or copy skills/* directly into your active skills folder), run python skills/xpublish/scripts/audit_engine.py skills/xboost --platform skill to verify the CLI harness, and confirm all 13 /x* commands are ready.
```

## Core Entrypoints & Universal Install

- [README.md](README.md): Architecture, benchmarks, one-prompt agent installer, and universal agent verification matrix.
- [scripts/install.ps1](scripts/install.ps1): Windows PowerShell installer (`./scripts/install.ps1 -All` or `-Target <dir>`).
- [scripts/install.sh](scripts/install.sh): macOS and Linux installer (`./scripts/install.sh --all` or `--target <dir>`).

## Skills & Bundled CLI Engines

- [skills/xboost/SKILL.md](skills/xboost/SKILL.md): BoostX deep reasoning, Ponytail x Deep Module design ladder, and Red-Green verification loop.
- [skills/xultra/SKILL.md](skills/xultra/SKILL.md): Elastic Cognitive Swarm (`K`-vector tournament, evolutionary ratchet, and blind Maker-vs-Checker verification).
- [skills/xdeep-research/SKILL.md](skills/xdeep-research/SKILL.md): 5-wave primary-source research and blind adversarial audit.
- [skills/xdeep-research/scripts/verify_evidence.py](skills/xdeep-research/scripts/verify_evidence.py): Automated URL, citation, and evidence gate verifier (`252` LOC).
- [skills/xlaya/SKILL.md](skills/xlaya/SKILL.md): System 1 (`choice`, `score`, `noul`) semantic decision and conflict triage sidecar.
- [skills/xlaya/scripts/laya_triage.py](skills/xlaya/scripts/laya_triage.py): Fence-safe `<=1,200`-char heading chunker (`#L<start>-L<end>`) and English/Multilingual `convaiinnovations/laya` runner (`617` LOC).
- [skills/xobsidian/SKILL.md](skills/xobsidian/SKILL.md): 2-Hop Hub + Cross-Domain Bridge knowledge graph maintenance and 1-line Graph Integrity Verification Gate.
- [skills/xocr/SKILL.md](skills/xocr/SKILL.md): Hybrid PyMuPDF vector/table extractor, Thai PUA normalizer, and 4-tier OCR engine.
- [skills/xocr/scripts/ocr_runner.py](skills/xocr/scripts/ocr_runner.py): CLI engine for PDF/image text and RFC-4180 CSV table extraction (`1,484` LOC).
- [skills/xplan/SKILL.md](skills/xplan/SKILL.md): Architectural implementation planner with inline grilling and verification matrices.
- [skills/xbrief/SKILL.md](skills/xbrief/SKILL.md): Same-turn workspace architecture loader and invariant extractor.
- [skills/xsync/SKILL.md](skills/xsync/SKILL.md): Post-change documentation synchronization and stale-reference purger.
- [skills/xsync/scripts/audit_workspace_docs.py](skills/xsync/scripts/audit_workspace_docs.py): Automated metric, version, cross-repo `--federated` mirror, and dead-link scanner (`454` LOC).
- [skills/xpublish/SKILL.md](skills/xpublish/SKILL.md): Unified pre-flight secret/AST/YAML auditor, upstream PR review-bot convergence gate, and QGIS 4 release packager (`/xpublish`, `/xpublish-audit`, `/xpublish-qgis`, `/publish`).
- [skills/xpublish/references/github_readme_protocol.md](skills/xpublish/references/github_readme_protocol.md): GitHub Repository Publishing & Visual README Protocol `v1.3` (including `§6.D` Upstream PR Etiquette & Review-Bot Convergence).
- [skills/xpublish/references/qgis_release_protocol.md](skills/xpublish/references/qgis_release_protocol.md): 5-Gate Deterministic QGIS 4 / Qt6 Release Packaging Protocol.
- [skills/xpublish/scripts/audit_engine.py](skills/xpublish/scripts/audit_engine.py): Zero-dependency AST/YAML/regex security, skill budget, and diff-scoped PR linter (`--platform pr|github|qgis|food4rhino|skill|generic`, `1,049` LOC).
- [skills/xpublish/scripts/package_qgis.py](skills/xpublish/scripts/package_qgis.py): Single-root ZIP builder and `metadata.txt` validator (`553` LOC).
- [skills/xpublish/scripts/check_qt6.py](skills/xpublish/scripts/check_qt6.py): Qt6/QGIS 4 scoped-enum AST compatibility verifier (`395` LOC).
- [skills/xcreate-skill/SKILL.md](skills/xcreate-skill/SKILL.md): Global skill builder, distiller, and evolutionary auditor.
- [skills/xcontext/SKILL.md](skills/xcontext/SKILL.md): Session context window, compaction, and SQLite token telemetry inspector.
- [skills/xcontext/scripts/check_context.py](skills/xcontext/scripts/check_context.py): Transcript and `.vscdb` token usage analyzer (`646` LOC).
- [skills/xkickoff/SKILL.md](skills/xkickoff/SKILL.md): End-of-session progress synthesizer and fresh-session handoff generator.
